author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA+DAQB override: k_total=45 (kd=22, δ=0.12, emb_k=17, γ_max=0.70)
abstract: Sparser-graph ablation around the frozen baseline: lower k_total from 50→45 while holding kd=22, δ=0.12, λ=0.605, emb_k=17, γ_max=0.70 constant. Tests if modest sparsification mitigates hubness without harming PCR/cLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=45,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
